title: Duffey Lake
summary: A long, slow glide over turquoise water between the Coast Mountains.
story: Duffey Lake sits on the winding road between Pemberton and Lillooet: dark forest, snow-dusted peaks and water so still it doubles the mountains.

title: Bow Lake: Glacier Blue
summary: Pull over. The lake is waiting.
story: A stop along the Icefields Parkway, where Crowfoot Glacier spills down toward Bow Lake. Wildflowers on the shore, that impossible glacier-fed blue, and nowhere else to be.

title: Drumheller Badlands: Prairie Light
summary: Highway 9 east, into the valley of hoodoos.
story: Canola fields give way to layered badlands as the road drops into the Red Deer River valley, carved over millions of years.

title: Elfin Lakes: Golden Ascent
summary: Sunrise on the Diamond Head trail.
story: Eleven kilometres up through Garibaldi's alpine meadows, chasing first light on the peaks above Elfin Lakes.

title: Chilliwack Lake: Frozen Silence
summary: Fresh snow over the frozen lake.
story: First tracks across the ice on a still winter morning in the Fraser Valley. The only sound is snow underfoot.

title: Shannon Falls: Sea to Sky
story: Just off the Sea-to-Sky Highway, Shannon Falls tumbles down granite cliffs through moss and ferns.

title: Manning Park: Four Seasons
story: One park, four seasons, from alpine wildflowers in full bloom to quiet winter trails.

title: Boundary Bay
summary: Tidal flats and green water from above.
story: Drone footage over the wide, shallow tidal flats of Boundary Bay, just south of Vancouver.
